title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
premise: In Regency England the five Bennet sisters need to marry well. Elizabeth, the sharp-witted second daughter, takes an instant dislike to the proud and wealthy Mr. Darcy.

moments.title: Darcy’s snub at the Meryton ball
moments.happened: Within Elizabeth’s hearing, Darcy calls her “tolerable, but not handsome enough to tempt me.”

moments.title: Wickham tells his story
moments.happened: The charming officer Wickham tells Elizabeth that Darcy cheated him of his inheritance, and she believes every word.
alternatives: Elizabeth doubts Wickham from the start

moments.title: Mr. Collins proposes
moments.happened: Her pompous cousin proposes. Elizabeth refuses him, and he marries her friend Charlotte instead.

moments.title: Darcy’s first proposal
moments.happened: At Hunsford, Darcy proposes while insulting her family. Elizabeth refuses and accuses him of ruining Jane’s happiness.

moments.title: Darcy’s letter
moments.happened: Darcy hands Elizabeth a letter revealing Wickham’s true character and explaining his part in separating Jane and Bingley.

moments.title: Lydia elopes
moments.happened: Lydia runs off with Wickham, threatening the whole family’s reputation.

moments.title: Darcy’s secret rescue
moments.happened: Darcy tracks the couple down and pays Wickham to marry Lydia, asking that no one ever know.

moments.title: Lady Catherine’s visit
moments.happened: Lady Catherine demands Elizabeth promise never to marry Darcy. Elizabeth refuses.
alternatives: Lady Catherine never hears the rumour
